resources.string: Off. It turns itself off 24 hours after you turn it on.
On until %1$s, then it turns itself off.

A log holds how the app connects, each request\'s route and ids, its status, time and size, the live feed\'s event types and sizes, the screens you open, and errors with their stack traces. It never holds prompts, replies, commands, file contents, file names, tool arguments, session or project names, tokens, certificates, keys or pairing codes. It stays on this phone until you send or share it.
Crashes are saved even with this off, stack trace only, in a small file of their own, and go along when you send or share.
